description: Structured output from process-pr skill for batch processing

status.description: Final status of PR processing. "approved" means the review passed and the PR is ready to merge, but the skill did NOT merge it — the orchestrator performs the merge in shell via merge-mr.sh so the concluded-check-failure guard cannot be bypassed (issue #853). "merged" is retained for older skill revisions that merged internally; the orchestrator reconciles it against GitHub rather than trusting it.

follow_up_issues.description: Issue numbers created as follow-ups from code review

error.description: Error message if status is error or rate_limit
